session.why: classifyRoute("/api/admin/placements/offers") returns "admin" (the /api/admin/ prefix); the handler re-verifies the caller with verifyAdminAuth, and a mutation also requires a session admin.

rls_class.why: The page writes offers and advertisers, Class B by Spec 114 §2 with the ONE ruled admin-read pattern (RLS on, one <table>_select_admin policy, no write policy); MF-40 D-1 (operator 2026-11-10) drops the move to an advertiser class (admin input only). placements, which it reads, is Class E (one public select policy, seed-only). The routes read and write through the owner connection, so the policies are defence in depth.

classes.ui: The page is not reachable without an admin session (requireAdminPage); a client call gets UNAUTHORIZED.
A non-session admin credential gets SESSION_REQUIRED.

Validation and placement-rule refusals (VALIDATION_FAILED, TARGETING_NOT_ALLOWED, SCENARIO_REQUIRED, SCENARIO_UNKNOWN, INVALID_DATE, FLIGHT_ORDER, FLIGHT_BEYOND_HORIZON, ADVERTISER_UNKNOWN, ADVERTISER_INACTIVE): the form shows its error state from content.
NOT_FOUND: the offer is gone; the error state from content.

STALE_OFFER: the offer changed since the page read it (a stale or missing updated_at, or a create that lost a race on the same offer_id); the form shows its error state from content and the list must be reloaded.
The persistent error toast from content; the request is logged.

emits.why: Each accepted request writes one admin_audit_log row; refusals on a placement rule log a structured warn.
